caption: The drawing depicts a circular, medallion-like object featuring a relief of a chicken or rooster standing in profile facing left. The bird has a prominent comb on its head, a rounded body with semilunar feather patterns, two legs with visible claws, and a large, ornate tail with curved feather details. The background within the circular frame is textured with small, simple cross shapes and dash marks, possibly indicating ground or a decorative pattern. The entire composition uses shades of brown and tan, giving the drawing a monochromatic appearance that resembles wood or a carved wooden plaquette. The circular medallion is centered on a plain, light background.
title: Pa. German Butter Mold
